runtime_overlay: Qualified FP8 stable-descriptor port and independent fixture callback, identical in all arms.

actual_paths.cached_default: search_cache returns True with tactic -1 from live winner bank (cold) or legacy loaded-file map (warm), then choose_one returns it without miss handling.
actual_paths.uncached_default: Manual role_scope clears winner/file maps before the measured batch; search_cache returns False,0,-1,None; choose_one additionally executes miss handling before returning the same tactic.
actual_paths.python_native_dispatch: CublasFp8GemmRunner.forward has an early tactic==-1 branch that calls module.bmm_fp8 for BOTH paths.
actual_paths.native: bmm_fp8 invokes bmm_fp8_internal_cublaslt, which creates descriptors, asks cuBLASLt for one heuristic and runs it. A cached -1 does not bypass this heuristic or use the explicit-descriptor resolved cache.
actual_paths.timing: Each eager public call repeats Python lookup/dispatch. Graph replay repeats captured GPU work without those Python decisions. Context snapshot/restore and native/lookup observation are outside timed batches.

interpretation: When v2 selected -1, the eager comparison measured a cached-default hit against an uncached-default miss. Both reach the same native heuristic-default GEMM path; source inspection confirms extra Python cache-miss handling in the control. The observed eager improvement includes host lookup/dispatch behavior and is not evidence of a faster selected GPU kernel. Its full magnitude has not been causally attributed by CPU profiling. Matching replay signatures and near-one graph ratios support keeping those conclusions separate.
